note: v2508: The v2506 orphan rule summed all of reach.values including keys outside SOURCES, so an undeclared source could account for its own contribution and the check went quiet. It sums only declared sources now. My first two guards for this were both worthless and the sabotage said so - one recomputed the rule inside the test so breaking the real one left it green, the other asserted something that cannot happen. The rule is extracted so it can be sabotaged at all.
